Key: # Oak Hill's quests (2026-11-18). One row per quest; the steps are in QuestsSteps.csv and the people in QuestsPeople.csv.
# Key: the quest's name for the game. Saves remember quests by Key
Title: so never change a Key once players have the quest (every other column can be changed).

Key: # Giver: the Key of the person in QuestsPeople.csv who offers it. Needs: what you must have first
Title: separated by ";": a skill and level ("Mining 10") or "Quest <Key>".

Key: # Summary: the quest log's description. Offer: what the giver says when offering it. Reminder: what the giver says while you are busy with it.
# NotYet: what the giver says when your quests are done but a skill level is too low (leave empty to say nothing). Done: what is said when the last step is handed in.

Title: Reminder
Giver: NotYet and Done a "|" starts a new line of speech (one click each). Keep lines short.

Key: # RewardItems: item names or keys with "x" and how many
Title: separated by ";" ("Healing Potion x2; TinOre x5"). The pack must have room when you hand in.
then restart the game and the world servers (the server's copy decides everything).
Kindling for the Cold
Summary: Marta Fernside, Oak Hill's steward, needs logs for the town woodpile before the cold sets in.
Offer: Oh, a new pair of hands! Bless you.|The nights are drawing in and the town woodpile is near bare. Blackrock bought every cart of coal on the river, so it's wood or nothing for us.|Could you bring me five logs from the oaks round town? Your axe is in your pack.
Reminder: Five logs for the woodpile, love. The oaks just outside town are best.
Done: You've a kind heart. Oak Hill doesn't forget kindness.|Here, it isn't much, but take it.

Title: A Cold Forge
Summary: Marta is worried about Pell, the smith's lad, who keeps Oak Hill's forge going on his own.
Offer: There's another thing weighing on me, if you've the time.|Young Pell has kept the forge alone since his master went over to Blackrock. He's too proud to ask for help.|Would you look in on him by the smithy? Tell him Marta sent you.
Reminder: Have you seen Pell yet? He's at the smithy, by the bridge on the west road.
Done: Thank you for looking after him. Here's something from the town chest.

Title: Supper for the Watch
Summary: Nan Bramble wants to bake a fish pie for the watch, who guard the river every night.
Offer: You're the one who got Pell's forge going! Then perhaps you can help an old baker too.|The watch stands at the river every night, and those lads haven't had a hot supper in a week.|Four perch would make a fine pie. The pond south of Blackrock is full of them, though they'd rather we didn't know.
Reminder: Four perch, dear. Your fishing pole is in your pack.
Done: He liked it? Of course he did.|Take these for your trouble. Drink them only when you need them.

Title: The Ways of Blackrock
Summary: Captain Corin wants to know how Blackrock's knights fight, in case it ever comes to that.
Offer: You've been a friend to this town, so I'll be plain with you.|Blackrock's knights grow bolder every week. If it ever comes to blows, I want someone here who knows how they fight.|They keep a sparring knight in the old pig pen north-east of their walls. Best him twice in a fair bout, and tell me how he moves.
Reminder: Best their sparring knight twice. Keep your shield up and watch for his raised sword.
Done: You fight like one of us. The watch would be glad to call you a friend.|Take this, and keep that shield high.

Title: Stones in the Wood
Summary: Wil Thatch wants to know if the old stone ruins in the forest are real.
Offer: Psst! You're grown up, so you're allowed in the deep woods, right?|Gran says there are old stone towers out in the forest. Older than Oak Hill. Older than Blackrock, even.|Nobody believes me. Could you find one and tell me what it's like? Please?
Reminder: Found one yet? Gran says they're deep in the woods, a good walk from town.
Done: Here, I saved these. They make you run fast. You might need to run fast in the woods.

Title: Iron for the Gate
Summary: Pell needs iron ore to forge new hinges for the river gate.
Offer: Back again! The forge has been good to us since you came.|Corin says the river gate's hinges are rusting through. Tin won't hold a gate; I need iron.|Five lumps of iron ore would do it. The dark rocks in the hills have it, if you can work them.
Reminder: Five lumps of iron ore. The dark rocks, mind: the grey ones are tin.
NotYet: I'd ask your help with iron, but it's hard to dig. Come back when you're a better miner.
Done: The town owes you again. Here's your share, from me and from Corin.

Title: Thieves on the Road
Summary: Bandits have made camp in the forest round Oak Hill. Captain Corin wants them thinned out before they rob another cart.
Offer: You there, friend. A word, if you've a moment.|Bandits have made camp in the woods round town. They stopped Nan's flour cart last week and took the lot.|There are three of us in the watch, and we can't leave the river. Could you thin them out? Four of them should make the rest think twice.
Reminder: Four bandits, friend. Their camps are off the roads, deep in the trees. Mind the big ones with shields: there's no shame in running.
Done: Four of them? The carts will roll easier this week, thanks to you.|Here's the watch's thanks. It isn't much, but it's honest.

Title: Red Hal
Summary: The bandits answer to Red Hal, who holds an old stone ruin in the forest. Captain Corin wants him beaten.
Offer: Those bandits you scattered? They'll be back, as long as Red Hal leads them.|He camps at one of the old stone ruins out in the forest, in a gold breastplate he never paid for, behind a shield he took off a Blackrock knight.|He hits hard and he doesn't fight alone. Rest up, take a potion or two, and best him. Then come and tell me.
Reminder: Red Hal camps at an old ruin in the forest. Watch for his raised sword and keep your shield up.
Done: Red Hal, beaten! The whole town will hear of it by supper.|Take this, with the watch's thanks. And Nan says there's a pie with your name on it.
RewardItems: Vigour Potion x1; Healing Potion x2
